concepts.gloss_en: Raising of the feminine waters (mayin nukvin) — the kabbalistic elevation of yearning/love in Torah, prayer and peacemaking that unifies and rectifies the worlds

reason_for_human: All 7 occurrences are the identical fixed kabbalistic term הַעֲלָאַת מַיִּין נוּקְבִין, vocalized the same everywhere. The 'variant' נעשׂה העלאת מיין נוקבין is just the verb נעשׂה ('is made/becomes') attached to the same phrase — not a distinct concept — so it belongs in the same group.
